name: Mountain West Cross Country Championships
headline: Mountain West Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: New Mexico swept both titles. The No. 1 Lobo men scored 15 points, with Air Force second (54) and Wyoming third (84), and New Mexico's Evans Kiplagat won the 8K in 22:54.3. The No. 6 New Mexico women scored 19 to Wyoming's 55 and Air Force's 58, and Pamela Kosgei won the 6K in 18:49.4.
